text:
Lodash is bumped to 4.17.21 (from 4.17.15), but the tests don't pass: 3 fail in `src/utils/date-utils.spec.js` ("formats DST boundary in America/New_York", "parses local midnight", "rolls over month end in local tz").

My stash comparison doesn't show these failures predate the bump. `git stash` reverts `package.json` and the lockfile but not `node_modules`, so the second run still used lodash 4.17.21. Also, the environment reports this directory isn't a git repo, so I can't confirm the stash and pop did what I expected. Check that `package.json` still lists 4.17.21.

The test names point to a timezone-dependent environment rather than lodash, but that's an inference. To confirm, run `npm install lodash@4.17.15 && npm test`. Then run `TZ=America/New_York npm test` on 4.17.21. If the old version fails the same 3 tests, the bump is clean. I haven't changed anything to fix them.

I also didn't check the npm registry. 4.17.21 is the latest 4.x release I know of.
